items.name: SST39SF010-90-4C-PH parallel flash 128Kx8, DIP-32 (old stock, non-A version), 3-piece lots, DOMESTIC - RECOMMENDED first buy
items.source: n11.com store 'ackelektronik' (Istanbul): 579.64 TL per 3-piece lot (basket price, list 623.27), free shipping
items.in_stock: Yes, 'Son 2 ürün': only 2 lots (6 chips) left, page data 27 Oct 2026
items.notes: Ships from Turkey, so there is no customs exposure, and n11 returns/buyer protection apply. This is the original non-A SST part: same pinout, same JEDEC command set and same chip ID 0xBFB5 as the SST39SF010A. The open-source minipro/XGecu device database has ONE combined entry 'SST39SF010,SST39SF010A' (chip_id 0xBFB5) in both its TL866II+ section and its newer T-series section, so you program it with the same setting. 90 ns is ample at 1-2 MHz with the registered control word (250 ns half-cycle at 2 MHz). It is old stock, possibly pulls, so on arrival read the ID, blank-check, and run a full erase/program/verify of every chip on the T48. Six chips cover 4-5 microcode ROMs plus the program ROM and font ROM with little or no spare; the next items cover the balance to 10.

items.name: SST39SF010A-70-4C-PHE parallel flash, DIP-32 (EOL), AliExpress single pieces (balance to reach 10; only if you accept an import parcel)
items.source: AliExpress (tr.aliexpress.com), 1 pc/lot, price shown in TRY
items.notes: PDIP-32 is END-OF-LIFE: DigiKey 'Obsolete, no longer manufactured', no stock (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/microchip-technology/SST39SF010A-70-4C-PHE/2297826); Mouser lists Obsolete with discontinuation notice dated 10 Apr 2026 (Microchip PCN CAAN-08FCZP770). The SST39SF020A/040 PDIP are also Obsolete at DigiKey. Broker stock exists (findchips: IBS Electronics ~9,207 pcs at ~USD 3.93-4.29 = ~196-214 TL). No Turkish shop (direnc, robotistan, motorobit, ozdisan) lists it. AliExpress chips are old or broker stock: on arrival read the chip ID (BF/B5) and do full erase/program/verify on the T48; buy 2-3 spares. Price excludes import costs. In 2026 every AliExpress parcel risks thousands of TL in extra clearance demands (see CUSTOMS in findings), so this is cheap only on paper: 4 pcs = ~394 TL, 10 pcs = ~986 TL before import costs.

items.name: ALTERNATIVE: SST39SF010A-70-4C-NHE flash, PLCC-32 (active, genuine)
items.in_stock: DigiKey live check: Active, 4,047 in stock, 17-week factory lead time
items.notes: Microchip's recommended replacement for the EOL DIP part, same die and pinout functions. Each breadboard position needs a PLCC32-to-DIP32 adapter (next item). Supported by T48 and TL866II+ as 'SST39SF010A @PLCC32'. AliExpress also has PLCC-32 lots (5 pcs TRY 462.34 = ~92 TL/pc, https://tr.aliexpress.com/item/1005007314702843.html). This is the genuine way to get the balance of 4-6 chips: put them in the single distributor order (see findings) and mount each on a PLCC32-to-DIP32 adapter.

items.name: PLCC32 to DIP32 converter adapter (only for the PLCC route; also fits the programmer ZIF)
items.notes: Price includes KDV. Motorobit sells it for 101 TL + KDV (121.20 TL), stock unclear: https://www.motorobit.com/plcc32-to-dip32-converter-adapter . You'd need about 5-6 (one per ROM socket plus one for the programmer).

items.name: CY62256LL-70PC 32Kx8 SRAM, DIP-28 (old stock), 2-piece lots, DOMESTIC - RECOMMENDED
items.source: n11.com store 'ackelektronik': 925.21 TL per 2-piece lot (basket price, list 994.85)
items.notes: Buy 2 lots (4 chips, 1,850.42 TL): 3 needed plus 1 spare. It is a standard JEDEC 62256 (32Kx8, 0.6 in DIP-28) and drops into the AS6C62256 footprint. 70 ns is fine for RAM and VRAM at 1-2 MHz and for the 1.27 us VGA character slot. Cypress old stock from a discontinued line, so test each chip with the T48 'Standard SRAM 62256' test on arrival. The same seller also has HY62256ALP-10 DIP (100 ns), 2 pcs for 925.21 TL (https://www.n11.com/urun/hy62256alp-10-dip-hyundai-entegreler-2-adet-128902459), and one uPD43256BCZ-85LL DIP-28 for 604.50 TL (https://www.n11.com/urun/d43256bcz-85ll-dip-28-256k-bit-cmos-statik-ram-32k-kelime-124109748). The unit price is about 6.6x AliExpress, but it is still cheaper than one 2026 parcel-clearance bill.

items.name: AS6C62256-55PCN 32Kx8 SRAM, DIP-28, AliExpress 10-pack (alternative, import)
items.source: AliExpress, sold as a 10-piece lot for TRY 698.33

Genuine option: DigiKey live check shows Active, 5,480 in stock, USD 9.93 (~494 TL) at qty 1, 20-week lead time (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/alliance-memory-inc/AS6C62256-55PCN/4234592). No Turkish retailer found. It is only worth it if it travels in the same parcel as other imports and that parcel clears without broker fees; a 10-pack on its own is a separate parcel from a separate seller.

items.name: NOT RECOMMENDED: AT28C256 DIP-28 from AliExpress
items.notes: HIGH fake/used risk. The listing names old Atmel non-RoHS codes (-15PC/-15PI/-12PC) that were discontinued long ago, so the chips must be pulled, used or re-marked. Mixed 10-piece lots at ~30 TL/pc (https://tr.aliexpress.com/item/1005012233123134.html) are almost certainly not genuine. Hobbyists commonly report chips that won't write, are locked by software data protection (SDP), or are other parts re-marked. This is not cheaper than DigiKey after import duty.

items.name: XGecu T48 (TL866-3G) universal programmer - RECOMMENDED

items.name: ZIF socket 40-pin DIP (0.6 in wide), used for the 28-pin and 32-pin wide chips

items.name: 25.000 MHz crystal oscillator, DIP-8 half-size metal can, 5-piece lot, DOMESTIC - RECOMMENDED VGA clock
items.source: n11.com store 'ackelektronik': 462.77 TL per 5-piece lot (basket price, list 497.60)
items.in_stock: Yes, but 'Son 1 ürün': ONLY 1 lot left, so buy it first
items.notes: The listing photo shows a 4-pin DIP-8 half-size metal can marked 25.000MHz, an active oscillator rather than a bare crystal. Supply voltage and output type are not stated; most such cans are 5 V TTL/HCMOS. On arrival, check the half-can pinout (pin 8 = +5 V, pin 4 = GND, pin 5 = out, pin 1 = NC/enable) and look at the output on the scope. The minimum purchase is the 5-piece lot (462.77 TL), which leaves spares. Divided by 2 it gives a 12.5 MHz dot clock: 31.25 kHz line and 59.5 Hz frame with your 400x525 timing (0.7% fast), which practically all monitors accept.

findings:
EXCHANGE RATE: 1 USD = 49.8 TRY, 1 EUR = 55.7 TRY (market quotes 20-23 Oct 2026; Ozdisan's TRY/USD pair implies 49.84; TCMB 23 Oct selling rate 49.65). DigiKey prices are converted at 49.8 and exclude 20% KDV, shipping and import costs. Turkish shop prices include KDV unless marked '+ KDV'. n11 prices are the 'sepette' (in-basket) prices.

MAIN CHANGE AFTER THE VERIFICATION PASS: personal imports in 2026 carry a fixed cost of several thousand TL per parcel (see CUSTOMS), so domestic stock beats AliExpress even at 2-7x the unit price. The pass found an n11 store, 'ackelektronik' (ships from Turkey), selling old-stock memories and DIP oscillator cans: SST39SF010-90 DIP-32 (6 chips), CY62256LL-70PC DIP-28 (6 chips), real 25.000 MHz oscillator cans (one 5-piece lot left), and 2.048 MHz and 4 MHz cans. Photos were checked to confirm metal-can oscillators.

RECOMMENDED BUY PLAN (all domestic, no customs). (1) n11 ackelektronik: 2 lots SST39SF010-90 (6 chips) 1,159.28 TL; 2 lots CY62256LL-70PC (4 chips) 1,850.42 TL; 1 lot 25.000 MHz half-can (5 pcs) 462.77 TL, ONLY ONE LOT LEFT, buy it first; 1 lot 2.048 MHz DIP-14 can (5 pcs) 462.77 TL. Subtotal 3,935.24 TL. (2) direnc.net: XGecu T48 4,358.82; 4x 40-pin ZIF 232.48; Arduino Mega 2560 clone 833.70; 2x HD15 female 69.74; 8x bar graph 158.08; a few 25 MHz HC-49S crystals (6.97 each) as spares. (3) elektrovadi: 8-ch 24 MHz logic analyzer 374.23. (4) motorobit: 2x mini-DIN-6 female 89.68; 4x common-cathode 7-seg 29.08. (5) Trendyol: KEEPRO PS/2 keyboard ~640. TOTAL about 10,720 TL for this whole list (about 36% of the 30,000 TL budget) with zero import exposure. Trade-offs: 6 flash chips instead of 10 (enough for 4-5 microcode ROMs plus the program and font ROMs, but little or no spare), 25.000 MHz instead of 25.175 MHz, old-stock parts (test on arrival; n11 returns apply), and no AT28C256. Optional extras: Kingst LA1010 16-ch 5,114.35 TL; domestic 4 MHz cans 555.32 TL per 4.

OPTIONAL SINGLE IMPORT: do this only if you need the exact 25.175 MHz clock, more flash spares or the AT28C256. Place ONE DigiKey order, ideally through the university's purchasing/BAP office or DigiKey's Turkish partner EKOM, containing 2x ECS-100A-251.7 (USD 8.12), 4-6x SST39SF010A-70-4C-NHE PLCC (USD 1.98 each) with PLCC32-DIP32 adapters from direnc (58.12 TL each), and 2x AT28C256-15PU (USD 23.24). That is about USD 39 (~1,960 TL) of parts, but expect ~390 TL KDV plus roughly 3,000-5,000 TL of courier/broker clearance (or EKOM's landed-price margin) and unknown DigiKey shipping: ESTIMATE ~5,500-7,500 TL landed, several times the parts value. The total would then be ~16,000-18,500 TL. Never split imports into several parcels. The first-pass AliExpress plan (SST39SF010A DIP x10 = 985.90 TL plus AS6C62256 10-pack = 698.33 TL) is NOT recommended as the main route: two sellers means two parcels, each exposed to the clearance fees below.

CRITICAL AVAILABILITY: SST39SF010A DIP-32 IS END-OF-LIFE. DigiKey marks SST39SF010A-70-4C-PHE 'Obsolete, no longer manufactured' with no stock. Mouser lists it Obsolete with a discontinuation notice dated 10 Apr 2026 (Microchip PCN CAAN-08FCZP770). The pin-compatible PDIP SST39SF020A/SST39SF040 are also Obsolete at DigiKey. The PLCC-32 SST39SF010A-70-4C-NHE is Active (DigiKey USD 1.98, 4,047 in stock). Every DIP-32 chip on the market is therefore old or broker stock: the n11 non-A SST39SF010-90 (same chip ID 0xBFB5 and same programmer entry), AliExpress lots (~99 TL each), or brokers (~USD 4). The 'prefer DIP parts available new in 2026' rule no longer holds for this flash. Design around DIP-32 footprints, buy the domestic chips now, and keep the PLCC-NHE plus adapter route as the genuine backup. No Turkish hobby shop (direnc, robotistan, motorobit) stocks any DIP parallel memory. Ozdisan lists AT28C256-15PU with stock 0.

CUSTOMS 2026 (verify before ordering): Presidential Decision 10813 (Resmi Gazete 7 Jan 2026) removed the 30 EUR duty-free route for postal/express e-commerce parcels from 6 Feb 2026. News reports quote flat 30% duty for EU origin and 60% for non-EU (China, US) on goods plus shipping, +20% for OTV-list goods, and Karar (13 Jan 2026) says individuals effectively must use a customs broker. In practice AliExpress now collects tax at checkout, yet Sikayetvar complaints from Mar-May 2026 show parcels still held, with large extra demands from PTT or the clearance agent 'gnd Global'. Examples: 5,634 TL demanded for a 54.11 TL item already paid at 214.79 TL including tax (26 Mar 2026), and ~3,900 TL in another case (9 Apr 2026). The parallel import research documents a 770 TL item that cost ~10,400 TL in total (Karar, 14 Apr 2026: 3,984 brokerage + 1,908 inspection + ~4,500 tax). Budget roughly 4,000-6,000 TL of overhead per small parcel. Student route: the MODEL exemption code (Ministry of Trade circular, 30 Jan 2026) lets a courier clear non-commercial samples/components for education or R&D on a simplified declaration. Limits are 30 EUR per shipment and 5 shipments per month, with your TCKN, proof of enrollment and a university letter; ask your department. Distributors: Mouser Turkey ships FCA and collects duties, taxes and fees on delivery (free shipping over ~60 EUR per mouser.com.tr text). DigiKey's authorized Turkish partner EKOM (+90 212 590 97 15, info@e-kom.com) quotes landed prices including clearance and duties. Sources disagree on the details, so confirm the current procedure first.

FAKE/USED RISK. AT28C256 on AliExpress: HIGH. Listings use old Atmel '-15PC/-15PI/-12PC' codes that were discontinued long ago, so the chips are pulled, used or re-marked; commonly reported problems are chips that won't write, chips locked by SDP (the T48 can unlock SDP) and re-marked other parts. After import costs they are not cheaper than a genuine USD 11.62 DigiKey part. SST39SF010A DIP on AliExpress: MEDIUM, since all stock is old or broker stock. AS6C62256 on AliExpress: MEDIUM (possibly re-marked or slower than marked, which doesn't matter at 1-2 MHz). n11 ackelektronik old stock: MEDIUM (old date codes, possibly pulls), but the seller is domestic and n11 returns apply. For every memory chip: read the ID, then run erase/program/verify or the T48 62256 SRAM test on arrival, and keep spares.

25.175 MHz OSCILLATOR AVAILABILITY: there is NONE in Turkey, as an oscillator or as a crystal. direnc, motorobit, robotistan, elektrovadi, ozdisan and n11 were all checked. The only stocked exact part is DigiKey ECS-100A-251.7 (14-DIP, 5 V, TTL output, USD 4.06 = ~202 TL, 1,120 in stock); its TTL output should feed a 74HCT input (e.g. a 74HCT74 for the /2). Mouser ECS-100AX-25.175 and DigiKey CTS MXO45HS-3C-25M175000 are non-stocked with a 1,000-piece minimum. 25 MHz IS the practical fallback. 25.000 / 2 = 12.5 MHz gives a 31.25 kHz line rate and a 59.5 Hz frame with your 400x525 timing (0.7% off spec), which practically all monitors accept. It is available domestically as a real oscillator can (n11 ackelektronik, 5 half-cans for 462.77 TL, only one lot left) or new from DigiKey (ECS-100A-250, USD 3.47, 655 in stock). It can also be built from a 25 MHz HC-49S crystal (direnc 6.97 TL) with a 74HCU04 Pierce oscillator. Keep the dot clock parameterised in the VGA timing generator so 25.175 MHz can be dropped in later. The Si5351 module (116 TL) can make 25.175 MHz exactly, but it needs a microcontroller to configure it at every power-up, so it is a lab tool only.
